description: Thursday 08:05: Keisha Robinson emails Reggie, in a new thread, her phone photo of the counseling office's tally of spring CTE elective requests as Angela Brooks updated it: four blue marks added after Advanced Fabrication's thirteen, 'late adds 12/9 - AB', for 17. The body names only the attachment, which lands in the Mail app's attachment store. Unread. Nothing announces it. Thursday 07:45: Coach Banks asks him to give DeShawn a ride to the cages on Saturday at 9 (DeShawn's mother is working), in a WhatsApp message to Reggie (unannounced). Thursday 09:20: Cedric Pope asks him to bring Jaylen's batting gloves on Saturday (Jaylen left them in his truck), in a WhatsApp message to Reggie (unannounced).
